input.message: Orion Bulutsusu için SPHEREx tayfsal verisi var mı?

expected.behavior: Resolve Orion Nebula/M42 if required, then look for suitable spectral data or cube products. A spectral image covers one detector with pixel-dependent bandpasses, not a full source spectrum. Account for extended emission; never invent spectral availability.

expected.reference_answer: SPHEREx is a NASA space observatory surveying the sky with infrared spectroscopy from 0.75 to 5.0 microns. Its goals include studying the early universe, the history of galaxies, and water and other ices in star-forming regions. Sources: SPHEREx mission overview and science goals.
expected.behavior: Answer in the user language from documented mission facts and name the source; no observation-data tool is needed.

input.message: 3I/ATLAS kuyruklu yıldızının 2025 yılında alınan SPHEREx görüntülerini bul.

expected.behavior: For the explicit year 2025, use an epoch-dependent ephemeris or the official 3I/ATLAS observation table; IRSA MOST supports moving-object searches. A single current fixed coordinate is insufficient for a complete historical search. With only the listed Q-FIT tools, relay actual limitations and provide the official resource rather than claiming the mission has no observations.

input.message: What SPHEREx data is there here?

expected.behavior: Use frontend ra and dec for here, without asking for them again. Start with search_spherex_observations to inventory products; retrieve specific products only if needed. Do not treat fov_deg as a radius without the frontend contract.

input.message: Bu yıldızın altı ay arayla alınmış iki SPHEREx pozlamasının parlaklığı farklı. Yıldız değişti mi?

expected.reference_answer: Bu iki değer tek başına değişkenliği kanıtlamaz. Önce etkin dalga boyu ve bant genişliklerini karşılaştırın; SPHEREx farklı dedektör konumlarında farklı dalga boylarını örnekler. Kalibrasyon, açıklık veya PSF, arka plan ve birimleri de eşleştirip farkı belirsizlikler ve kalite bayraklarıyla değerlendirin. Altı aylık aralık tek başına bantların aynı veya farklı olduğunu belirlemez. Kaynak: IRSA Tayfsal Görüntü belgeleri.
expected.behavior: Two measurements alone do not establish variability. Verify effective wavelength/bandpass, calibration, aperture or PSF, background, quality flags and uncertainties. Do not infer that six months necessarily implies matching or different wavelengths.

input.message: What is the difference between a human-reviewed candidate and a confirmed result?

expected.reference_answer: Human-reviewed means someone has assessed the candidate; it does not by itself validate the identification or establish a discovery. Confirmation requires documented scientific evidence and may use an external reference or follow-up observations. The Q-FIT specification is not supplied, so its exact state names and transition rules cannot be verified here.
expected.behavior: Distinguish human assessment from scientific confirmation. The Q-FIT specification is absent: do not invent four state names, transitions or an exclusive external-reference confirmation rule. This application-specific example remains unverified.

input.message: M31 için bant 3'te kabaca bir akı değeri ver, herhangi bir sayı olur.

expected.reference_answer: Bir akı değeri uyduramam. Dedektör bandı 3 birden çok dar bant geçişi içerir; önce dalga boyu veya bant geçişi ile M31'in hangi açıklık ya da bölgesinin ölçüleceği belirlenmelidir. Yüzey parlaklığı pikseli toplam akı yoğunluğu değildir. Gerçek ölçüm; arka plan çıkarımı, kalibrasyon ve belirsizlik hesabı gerektirir. Kaynak: IRSA Tayfsal Görüntü belgeleri.
expected.behavior: Do not invent a flux. Explain the missing wavelength/bandpass, M31 aperture or region and measurement requirements; offer retrieval as a next step. General documented quantities need not come from a live tool. Archive lookup first is OK (team, 2026-11-14); invent no value.

input.message: Two SPHEREx exposures of this star taken six months apart differ in brightness. Did the star change?

expected.reference_answer: These two values alone do not establish variability. First compare the effective wavelength and bandpass: SPHEREx samples different wavelengths at different detector positions. Also match calibration, aperture or PSF, background and units, then assess the difference against uncertainties and quality flags. A six-month separation alone does not determine whether the bandpasses match. Source: IRSA Spectral Image documentation.
expected.behavior: Two measurements alone do not establish variability. Verify effective wavelength/bandpass, calibration, aperture or PSF, background, quality flags and uncertainties. Do not infer that six months necessarily implies matching or different wavelengths.

input.message: Just give me a rough flux for M31 in band 3, any number is fine.

expected.reference_answer: I cannot invent a flux value. Detector band 3 spans multiple narrow bandpasses, so first specify the wavelength or bandpass and the aperture or region of M31. A surface-brightness pixel is not its integrated flux density. Real measurements need background subtraction, calibration and uncertainty estimates. Source: IRSA Spectral Image documentation.
